verified: Tom's Hardware, citing SCMP, reported that more than 20 Chinese PCB manufacturers announced expansion plans in the first half of 2026, and that China's MIIT and NDRC published a five-year plan in September targeting high-frequency, high-speed, multilayer PCBs, copper-clad laminate and low-profile copper foil; Dtech's own interim report states it has entered mass production of drill bits with aspect ratios above 40:1, and HSBC and KGI Securities research is cited for the layer counts and drilling difficulty.
unconfirmed: the shortage forecasts (24% drill-bit shortfall in 2027, 700 to 1,200 tonnes a month of HVLP4, 36% annual growth in holes per board, a 78-layer Rubin Ultra backplane) are bank estimates, not measured outcomes; Dtech's climb to 235 million bits a month by year-end and Defu's 50,000-tonne capacity plan are company targets, and the report gives no prices, customer qualification results, or independent verification of either firm's output.

verified: Tom's Hardware 援引 SCMP 报道，2026 年上半年有 20 多家中国 PCB 制造商公布重大扩产计划；广东鼎泰高科 2026 年中期业绩称已量产长径比超过 40:1 的钻针；德福科技 9 月出货约 700 吨 HVLP 铜箔；中国工信部和国家发改委 9 月发布了相关五年规划。
unconfirmed: 2027 年钻针 24% 的供应缺口、2026 和 2027 年 HVLP4 铜箔每月短缺约 700 吨和 1,200 吨、Rubin Ultra 背板 78 层等，均为汇丰、摩根大通或 KGI 的预测；中国厂商扩产能否通过客户认证并如期达产，也尚缺独立验证。

titles.en: China's AI hardware push extends to PCB drill bits and copper foil
titles.zh: 中国 PCB 供应链扩产钻针与铜箔，应对 AI 服务器需求
